newsitem.title: UK: TABLE-BA July traffic hit by strike.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-BA July traffic hit by strike.

text.p: British Airways Plc said paying passenger traffic in July fell 1.1 percent, hit by a three-day strike by cabin crew.
Capacity fell 0.9 percent to give an overall load factor of 77.7 percent -- down 0.2 percentage points on a year ago.
The airline said its premium business and first class traffic fell nine percent on a year ago, while main cabin traffic was up 0.2 percent.
